# Hulu

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Media product: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: light.

Hulu is the US streaming service from Hulu, LLC. This package is a public capture on 2026-11-22, signed out, from Singapore. `https://www.hulu.com/` returned 302 to Disney+ (`x-aka-user-geo: SG`). The pages that stayed on a Hulu host are the plan chooser, the empty login wall, the Help Center, and the press site. Desktop width was 1440 by 900. Phone width was 390 by 844. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This is not the signed-in player. `www.hulu.com` marketing paths redirected to Disney+ from Singapore. The plan chooser still served US prices.

SELECT hover was read as `rgba(4, 4, 5, 0.8)`. The resting fill was `rgb(4, 4, 5)`.

The plan page body is `#f7f7f9`. The login wall is a dark gradient behind a white card. The Help Center hero is dark. They are different surfaces.

The Help Center search border is `#15bc74`. The wordmark sample is `#1ce783`. They are not the same green.

No error, warning, or success colour was on the pages that were opened. Those roles are not in the tokens.

Spacing is not a named scale. Control height is on the measured buttons.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- Keep the plan page on `#f7f7f9`. SELECT is a black pill. The green is the wordmark and the help search border.
- Use a pill for SELECT. LOG IN on the plan header is text, not a filled button.
- Stop at the email wall and at SELECT. Do not treat the plan chooser as a completed signup.
